Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpOverview2_caption.Value
Item.Value: It displays each opportunity as a proportional flow from its starting forecast category (on the left) to its end-of-period outcome (on the right), so the largest movements stand out at a glance.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpReadRight_caption.Value

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.SankeyHelpReadWidth_caption.Value
Item.Value: Width of every node and flow is proportional to the opportunity amount: the left side uses the amount at the start, the right side uses the amount at the end, so a flow that widens or narrows reflects a change in amount.

Item.Value: How opportunities are counted

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpCountingIntro_caption.Value
Item.Value: When an opportunity has more than one movement in the same change period (for example, it was created and its Amount also changed), the chart decides which column it belongs to using this priority order:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpCountingNote_caption.Value
Item.Value: Most opportunities land in a single column this way. The exception is a deal that both entered and left the period within the same window — for example, created as New and then marked Closed Won. It is counted in two columns, its entry column (New) and its exit column (Won), so that the start and end totals reconcile.

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpDecreaseHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: Columns that reduce the period's open pipeline:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpIncreaseHead_caption.Value
Item.Value: Columns that increase the period's open pipeline:

Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.WaterfallHelpPriorityOrder_caption.Value
Item.Value: 1. Lost, 2. Won, 3. Slipped, 4. New, 5. Pulled In, 6. Pushed In, 7. Amount Increase, 8. Amount Decrease.
